How it works

Frequently Asked
Questions

Dessn is for product teams with an existing codebase. Designers, PMs, and engineers use it to explore and collaborate on product ideas directly in production code.

There is no lengthy implementation. Connect an approved repository and your first page is usually ready in minutes. Dessn learns the existing routes, components, and design system automatically.

Dessn supports React, Vue.js, Electron, and React Native apps. You can connect your codebase through either GitHub or GitLab.

Dessn requests read-only access to the repositories you approve through GitHub or GitLab. We do not access your backend, databases, or customer records. Dessn never writes, modifies, or pushes code back to your repository.

Yes. You can grant access only to specific GitHub repositories or GitLab projects. For monorepos, Dessn can be configured to work from the relevant project or subdirectory, and access can be revoked at any time.

No. Dessn does not train on your data. We use LLM providers that guarantee no training and zero data retention.

Yes. Dessn is fully SOC 2 Type II compliant. Contact us if you need a copy of the report for your security review.
